summary.mode: Actual React AuthProvider; two real same-origin tabs sharing localStorage; fake JWTs and in-memory login only.

checks.name: Two actual tabs start as guests in the isolated shared context
Signing in tab A synchronizes the member identity to tab B
Shared stored session matches its token
Switching account and role in tab A replaces tab B identity
Captured updates from account A cannot patch account B
Signout in tab A makes tab B a guest
Captured profile callbacks cannot resurrect a signed-out session
Mismatched session access_token and current token are rejected
An old same-account token callback cannot overwrite a renewed session
localStorage.clear propagates guest state to the peer tab
A saved user without a token remains a guest
Preset profile IDs avoid all profile and external API requests
No uncaught browser errors occurred across both tabs
